title: Favorite singers and pianists: Bessie Smith, Alonzo Johnson, Cooney Vaughn
summary: He heard the classic blues stars, names Bessie Smith as favorite, dislikes Blind Lemon's timing, and rates Cooney Vaughn best pianist.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
